text:
Silver Price in 1987
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1987, the LBMA silver price rose 20.8% between 1987-01-30 ($5.55) and 1987-12-31 ($6.70). The highest sampled price was $8.32 in July and the lowest was $5.47 in February. The mean of these observations was $7.05. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
